event_dates: between 15:40 Tuesday June 26, 2012 and 04:00 Wednesday June 2, 2012
key_impacts: Damage and destruction of residential structures occurred in the Mountain Shadows neighborhood.
Some structures were destroyed, others were damaged and extinguished, and undamaged structures were defended to prevent ignition (as categorized in the report).
Structure ignitions across the community are documented alongside first responder deployment timelines.
Fire extent and spotting affected multiple communities, including Cedar Heights and areas from Peregrine to Wolfe Ranch.
